name: Wand of Magic Missiles
description: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast magic missile from it. For 1 charge, you cast the 1st-level version of the spell. You can increase the spell slot level by 1 for each additional charge you expend. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn.
